mapper.select: SELECT p.merch_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(p.expect_date, p.due_date) < #{today}) AS late, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(p.expect_date, p.due_date) BETWEEN #{today} AND #{nearUntil}) AS near, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prd_node n WHERE n.prd_order_id = p.id AND n.actual_finish IS NULL AND n.plan_finish < #{today})) AS node_late FROM prd_order p JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.merch_id AND u.deleted = false AND u.status = 1 WHERE p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') GROUP BY p.merch_id

SELECT o.buyer_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS late FROM pur_order_item i JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.buyer_id AND u.deleted = false AND u.status = 1 WHERE o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND i.received_qty - i.returned_qty + i.offset_in_qty - i.offset_out_qty < i.qty AND COALESCE(i.expect_date, i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) < #{today} GROUP BY o.buyer_id
